'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Israel–Hezbollah conflict (2023–present)|Israel–Hezbollah conflict]]
**[[September 2024 Lebanon strikes]]
***[[2024 Hezbollah headquarters strike]]
****[[Hezbollah]] announces the death of its leader [[Hassan Nasrallah]] in yesterday's [[Israel Defence Forces|Israel]]i airstrikes in [[Beirut]], [[Lebanon]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/lebanons-hezbollah-confirms-leader-nasrallah-killed-2024-09-28/ (Reuters)]
****Interim [[Prime Minister of Lebanon|Lebanese Prime Minister]] [[Najib Mikati]] announces the country will have a national mourning period of three days for Hezbollah leader Hassan Nasrallah, starting on Monday. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2024/9/28/three-days-of-mourning-in-lebanon-for-slain-hezbollah-chief-nasrallah (Al Jazeera)]
****[[Iran]] confirms that [[Abbas Nilforoushan]], an [[Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps]] deputy commander, was killed in yesterday's airstrikes in Beirut. [https://english.alarabiya.net/News/middle-east/2024/09/28/irgc-deputy-commander-killed-in-israeli-strikes-on-beirut-report (Al Arabiya)] 
***The Israel Defense Forces begin a blockade of [[Beirut–Rafic Hariri International Airport]] in order to prevent the shipment of Iranian weapons to Lebanon. The blockade will not affect the operation of civilian flights at the airport. [https://www.jpost.com/israel-hamas-war/2024-09-28/live-updates-822145 (''The Jerusalem Post'')]
*[[Iran–Israel proxy conflict]]
**[[Red Sea crisis]]
***The [[Houthi movement|Houthis]] launch a [[ballistic missile]] from [[Yemen]] towards [[Ben Gurion Airport]] in [[Israel]], prompting [[Civil defense siren|air raid sirens]] in [[Tel Aviv]] and most of [[Central District (Israel)|Central]] Israel. [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/missile-fired-yemen-intercepted-israeli-military-says-2024-09-28/ (Reuters)]
*[[Insurgency in Balochistan]]
**Seven workers from [[Punjab, Pakistan|Punjab Province]] are killed and another injured during a [[mass shooting]] at a rented house in [[Panjgur District]], [[Balochistan, Pakistan|Balochistan Province]], [[Pakistan]]. [https://apnews.com/article/pakistan-gunmen-balochistan-attack-536da5b3d1a37b7bc8e7d896b4eaee23 (AP)]
*[[Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**Ten people are killed and 22 others are injured in a [[Russian Armed Forces|Russian]] [[double tap strike]] on a medical facility in [[Sumy]], [[Ukraine]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/russian-attacks-medical-centre-kill-6-people-ukraines-sumy-minister-says-2024-09-28/ (Reuters)]
*[[Somali Civil War (2009–present)|Somali Civil War]]
**At least six people are killed and ten others are injured when a [[car bomb]] explodes outside a restaurant in [[Mogadishu]], [[Somalia]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/least-six-killed-by-bomb-blasts-somalia-2024-09-28/ (Reuters)] [https://www.voasomali.com/a/7802845.html (VOA Somali)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2024 Atlantic hurricane season]]
**[[Hurricane Helene]]
***The death toll from Hurricane Helene in the [[United States]] increases to at least 64 people, including 21 in [[South Carolina]] and 18 in [[Georgia (U.S. state)|Georgia]]. [https://apnews.com/article/hurricane-helene-florida-georgia-north-carolina-south-carolina-92d5caaafe40644e1db687cf6431395f (AP)]
*[[2024 Mari Petroleum Mil Mi-8 crash]]
**A [[Mil Mi-8]] helicopter carrying [[Mari Petroleum]] employees crashes in [[North Waziristan District]], [[Khyber Pakhtunkhwa]], [[Pakistan]], killing six people and injuring eight others. [https://apnews.com/article/pakistan-helicopter-crash-waziristan-6a15ad3939c6f48fc7463b728374b6e3 (AP)]
*[[2024 Nepal floods]]
**At least 170 people are killed and 59 others are missing in [[flood]]s and [[landslide]]s in [[Nepal]]. [https://www.thejournal.ie/104-dead-64-missing-flooding-landslides-nepal-6499915-Sep2024/ (The Journal)]
*Nine people are killed, 27 others are rescued, and 48 others are missing when a boat carrying migrants capsizes off the coast of [[El Hierro]] in the [[Canary Islands]], [[Spain]]. [https://apnews.com/article/migrants-canary-islands-boat-spain-c0e23bb2e09e75e6538bebca71305b85 (AP)]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[United Nations Secretary-General]] [[António Guterres]] declares a warning at the [[United Nations General Assembly|UN General Assembly]] for nearly a billion people living in low-lying coastal areas due to the risk of [[Sea level rise|rising sea levels]] caused by [[climate change]] potentially resulting in catastrophic [[flooding]], [[coastal erosion]], and [[climate migration]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2024/9/28/coastal-communities-face-catastrophic-flooding-from-rising-sea-levels (Al Jazeera)]
